items.description: মেটার প্রধান নির্বাহী মার্ক জাকারবার্গের তিন মেয়ে সম্পদের সিংহভাগ উত্তরাধিকার হিসেবে পাবেন না। জীবদ্দশায় ফেসবুকের ৯৯ শতাংশ শেয়ার জনকল্যাণমূলক কাজে খরচের অঙ্গীকার করেছেন তিনি।

items.title: NRBC Bank to fund frozen food sector under BB scheme
items.description: NRBC Bank PLC has signed a pre-financing agreement with Bangladesh Bank to provide loans at concessional rates to export-oriented frozen food businesses under a Tk 2,000 crore refinancing scheme.

items.title: Eastland Insurance celebrates 40 years
items.description: Eastland Insurance PLC, a first-generation non-life insurance company, has celebrated its 40th anniversary with a gala event at the Radisson Blu Water Garden Hotel in Dhaka.

items.title: Midland Bank signs MoU with BRAC IT for technology collaboration
items.description: Midland Bank PLC (MDB) has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with BRAC IT Services Limited (brac IT) to explore potential collaboration in software development and technology-driven banking solutions.

items.title: Mercantile Bank joins BB’s Tk 2,000cr fund for frozen food sector
items.description: Mercantile Bank PLC has signed a participatory agreement with Bangladesh Bank to join the central bank’s Tk 2,000 crore pre-financing fund aimed at supporting the country’s export-oriented frozen food industry.

items.title: BRAC Bank to provide ACI with financing solutions
items.description: BRAC Bank has signed a comprehensive partnership agreement with ACI PLC to provide a range of banking and financing solutions, including digital and alternative financing, to the conglomerate and its subsidiaries.

items.title: Like cars, Chinese motorcycles out to conquer Europe
items.description: Just as with electric cars, Chinese motorcycle brands are roaring into European markets, with high-performance, cut‑price models starting to make a name for themselves.
